title: Under the Oaks Cottage in Blue Mountain Beach | Real Joy
h1: Under the Oaks Cottage in Blue Mountain Beach
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Four Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Space with a Cabana-Style Patio* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 1 Mile from Gulf View Heights Beach Access* 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center * S
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home! * Four Bikes Included * Great Outdoor Space with a Cabana-Style Patio* Walk to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery and Redfish Village * 1 Mile from Gulf View Heights Beach Access* 2 miles to Gulf Place Town Center * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs from November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please get in touch with us with your interest, and to further assist!Welcome to Under the Oaks Cottage in Blue Mountain Beach, a peaceful retreat nestled in a quiet neighborhood, yet just moments away from stunning beaches and top-notch restaurants. This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing getaway. Families will love the spacious layout and the fenced-in backyard, which is ideal for children to play safely. The fully equipped kitchen makes it easy for everyone to whip up delicious meals together. On the first floor, you'll find a king master bedroom with an en suite bathroom. Upstairs, there’s a queen bedroom, a room with a twin-over-full bunk bed with a twin trundle, and a loft space with a twin bed, accommodating up to 9 guests comfortably. Come stay at Under the Oaks Cottage and create unforgettable beach memories that will last a lifetime!Under the Oaks Cottage is located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach. Tucked in between the tranquil Big Redfish Lake and the emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico the Old Blue Mountain Beach community is conveniently located. You’ll be within a couple of blocks of Redfish Village with shops and restaurants, bike and surf rentals and other conveniences. Don’t forget to walk over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a homemade scoop! Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Explore Redfish Lake, one of the few coastal dune lakes in the world. Come and see for yourself what makes Blue Mountain Beach and the 30A area so special! The Bed Setup:1st FloorMaster Bedroom: King Bed2nd FloorGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Full Bunkbed with Twin TrundleLoft: Twin BedAREA ATTRACTIONS: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald, green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
